parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: $\overrightarrow{OM}=\mathbf i+2\mathbf j+2\mathbf k$ and $\overrightarrow{MN}=\mathbf i+\mathbf j-2\mathbf k$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Obtain $\overrightarrow{OM}=\mathbf i+2\mathbf j+2\mathbf k$. B1. Use a correct method to find $\overrightarrow{MN}$, for example $\overrightarrow{MO}+\overrightarrow{OA}+\overrightarrow{AN}$ or $\overrightarrow{MO}+\overrightarrow{ON}$. M1. Obtain $\overrightarrow{MN}=\mathbf i+\mathbf j-2\mathbf k$. A1; accept any notation. Total 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.answer: $\mathbf r=2\mathbf i+3\mathbf j+\lambda(\mathbf i+\mathbf j-2\mathbf k)$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use a correct method to form an equation for $MN$. M1; allow without $\mathbf r=\cdots$. Obtain $\mathbf r=2\mathbf i+3\mathbf j+\lambda(\mathbf i+\mathbf j-2\mathbf k)$. A1 FT OE; alternatively $\mathbf r=\mathbf i+2\mathbf j+2\mathbf k+\mu(\mathbf i+\mathbf j-2\mathbf k)$. Must have $\mathbf r=\cdots$ and follow part (a). Total 2.

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State $\overrightarrow{OP}$ for a general point $P$ on $MN$ in component form, for example $(2+\lambda,3+\lambda,-2\lambda)$. B1. Equate the scalar product of $\overrightarrow{OP}$ and a direction vector of $MN$ to zero and solve for $\lambda$. M1. Obtain $\lambda=-\dfrac56$. A1 OE; for the alternative parameter obtain $\mu=\dfrac16$. Obtain $\dfrac{\sqrt{53}}6$ correctly. A1 AG; for example from $\sqrt{(7/6)^2+(13/6)^2+(5/3)^2}$. Total 4.
